guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026

facts.detail: BDUK published the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review on 1 May 2026.
The consultation concluded and the closure notice was added on 1 June 2026.
The consultation ran from 3pm on 1 May 2026 to 5pm on 1 June 2026.
Suppliers were asked for premises-level information on existing and planned build over the next three years across the UK.
BDUK states that National Rolling OMR exercises take place in January, May and September.

facts.detail: BDUK published the Project Gigabit Evaluation Plan on 15 August 2025.
The evaluation covers Project Gigabit, the Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy and the Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme.
BDUK commissioned Ipsos UK and partners to undertake the evaluation.
GIS contracts subsidise gigabit-capable networks offering download speeds of at least 1,000 Mbps where commercial deployment is not expected.
The evaluation page describes Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme support worth up to £4,500 for homes and businesses.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit Evaluation Plan - detailed report

facts.detail: The detailed evaluation plan was authored by Ipsos UK as BDUK's independent evaluation contractor.
The report includes theory of change, process evaluation, impact evaluation and implementation sections.
Project Gigabit targets hard-to-reach homes and businesses outside suppliers' commercial plans.
The plan schedules GIS process-evaluation activity during 2026 and 2027.
The plan schedules a complete GIS impact, economic and financial evaluation toward the end of delivery around 2030.
